official_exmesh_protocol.paper_code_resolution_difference: The linked 2DGS archive contains 1554x1162 RGBA images. Released ExMesh uses resolution=-1 and only auto-resizes widths above 1600, so it consumes 1554x1162; PGSR separately uses -r2. Reproduction follows released code and records this difference.

official_exmesh_protocol.paper_code_initialization_difference: The released README and bundled PGSR runner differ from Section 4.1 of the paper; reproduction follows the released official repository and reports this difference.
